$comment: Logos for the map's systems. Keys are system names (or aliases) as in catalogue/systems.json. logo = full-colour logo, shown in the side panel and tooltip. mark = the brand's symbol alone, drawn in white on the system's node; null when the brand has none (the node shows initials). Files live in web/logos/; record where each came from in web/logos/SOURCES.md, and check each brand's usage guidelines before adding it. Example entry: "ERP": { "logo": "erp.svg", "mark": "erp-mark.svg", "source": "https://vendor.example/brand", "file": "https://vendor.example/brand/logo.svg" }
